Development projects

Hypothesis-api-client
A tiny npm module to simplify operations over the methods of Hypothes.is API in javascript, which is an awesome service for web annotation.
zeroclaw_config
Pure HTML/CSS/JS builder for ZeroClaw config.toml — no build step, no dependencies. Auto-generates its form from the official JSON Schemas (0.6.9 → 0.8.4), with live preview, draft save/load, TOML import with compatibility report, multilingual UI and full-text search. 100% client-side; your keys never leave the browser.
crypto-tax
Exchanges' ledgers parser to facilitate tax calculation in multiple crypto platforms.
dca-kraken
Node.js DCA automation for Kraken — two modes: SIMPLE (buy on every run) and SMART (buy when price drops X% or at period fallback). Supports multiple price strategies (current, lowest, VWAP, close average), multiple thresholds per period (e.g. 1:25,3:25,5:25,10:25), Binance price comparison and Telegram notifications. Cron-ready with simulator and persistent state.
EPlayer
An Electron-based multiplatform music player. Written in pure javascript html and css, extensible and pretty. Currently under development! Previously known as GCPlayer.
DBusBot
It was a chatbot to ask for arrival times of DBus company buses. Written using Microsoft Bot Framework. It is currently unavailable, due to changes in the politics of Microsoft Bot Framework services... But hopefully I'll rewrite it in the future using Telegraf.
Kaixo Mundua
A web portal to upload and share your own photos written in Python and managed by Google App Engine (archived).
Radio
A radio station player written in PHP, Javascript, HTML and CSS (archived).
